panels.title: Grade Cadence — Operator vs Auto (per day)
panels.description: HITL-REVIEW-001 grade throughput split by grader class. auto:* = autograder (invariant: never mutates substrate). operator = human grade (drives real reinforcement / draft approval / dismissal). Whitespace between operator bars = the queue is stalling. Steady auto:* volume without operator volume = HITL-AUTO-DISMISS-001 draining noise but genuine rules pending. Steady operator volume = curation loop healthy.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', time) AS time,
  CASE WHEN grader_id LIKE 'auto:%' THEN 'auto' ELSE 'operator' END AS metric,
  count(*) AS value
FROM review_grades
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Auto vs Operator Share (7d)
panels.description: Share of grades authored by autograder vs operator over the last 7d. HITL-CURATION-002 shipped auto-grading; HITL-AUTO-DISMISS-001 (2026-08-04) enabled auto-drain of dim=0 dismissals; AUTOGRADE-SCHEDULE-001 (2026-08-04) added scheduled runs. Expected steady state: majority auto (dismissals + advisory approvals) with a minority operator (substrate-mutating approvals of durable rules).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN grader_id LIKE 'auto:%' THEN 'auto' ELSE 'operator' END AS metric,
  count(*) AS value
FROM review_grades
WHERE time > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Pending Drafts Queue
panels.description: contradicted_correction_drafts.status = 'pending' count. Rises when the contradicted-bridge emits drafts; falls when operator grades (approve → status='approved' with L0 obs mint) or autograder dismisses via HITL-AUTO-DISMISS-001 (dim=0 → status='dismissed', no substrate mutation). Elevated + rising = curation stall (`hitl-curation` alert threshold: > 5 with 0 operator grades in 7d). AUTOGRADE-SCHEDULE-001 default-off; enable via REVIEW_AUTOGRADE_SCHEDULE_ENABLED=true for auto-drain.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(count(*), 0) AS pending
FROM contradicted_correction_drafts
WHERE status = 'pending'

panels.title: Draft Status Split (all-time)
panels.description: contradicted_correction_drafts by lifecycle status. approved = L0 obs minted (feeds L1 correction on next consolidation via JIMINY-CORRECTION-PRODUCER-001). dismissed = operator or auto rejected (JIMINY-CONTRADICTED-BRIDGE-QUALITY-001 upstream filter reduces future noise). pending = awaiting decision.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT status, count(*) AS value
FROM contradicted_correction_drafts
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Scheduled Autograde — Run History
panels.description: AUTOGRADE-SCHEDULE-001 (2026-08-04) supervised loop runs. success=true rows = auto-drain cycle completed. Failures alert via jobhealth (distinct service label `scheduled-autograde:<dataset>` per NOSILENT-001 cooldown contract). Empty when scheduler is disabled (default: REVIEW_AUTOGRADE_SCHEDULE_ENABLED=false).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT recorded_at AS time,
  job_name,
  success,
  latency_ms,
  COALESCE(error_message, '') AS error
FROM scheduled_job_events
WHERE job_name LIKE 'scheduled-autograde%'
  AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at)
ORDER BY recorded_at DESC
LIMIT 30

panels.title: Reinforcement Applied (7d) — Substrate Mutations
panels.description: review_grades.reinforcement_applied=true count over last 7d. This is the ONLY grade class that mutates the cognitive substrate (guidance sink: trust EMA + node confidence; contradicted_drafts sink: L0 correction obs mint via conversation.Correct). auto:* grades ALWAYS have reinforcement_applied=false (HITL-CURATION-002 invariant + HITL-AUTO-DISMISS-001 status-only NonReinforcingApplier). This chart is the honest count of operator-driven substrate change.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(count(*), 0) AS mutations_7d
FROM review_grades
WHERE reinforcement_applied = true
  AND time > now() - interval '7 days'
